content.text:
Here is a concise map of what exists in `/home/admin` for your six topics.

---

## 1. Learning journal vs. codebase wording

There is **no** string `學習日誌` or `journal` in `frontend/src`. The learning-evaluation UI is **學習評量** in **`/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/LearningRecordsPage.vue`**.

- **Main form modal** (add / edit / view): `showModal`, overlay `@click.self="closeModal"` — lines **393–560**.
- **Bulk “一鍵補登” modal**: `showBulkModal` — lines **149–** (overlay **150**).
- **Change-teacher modal**: `showChangeTeacherModal` — lines **339–391**.
- **Export modal**: `showExportModal` — lines **562–** (overlay **563**).

---

## 2. Student name display (`學生 #` / `學生#`)

| Location | Lines | Behavior |
|----------|-------|----------|
| Teacher path, readonly student in modal | **909–913** | `currentStudentName`: name from `studentList` or fallback `` `學生 #${studentId}` `` (note **space** before `#`). |
| Teacher schedule events (today/week widget) | **1371–1380** | `studentName`: `student?.name \|\| sc.student_name \|\| ` `` `學生#${...}` `` (**no** space before `#`). |
| Template: schedule cards | **101, 137** | `{{ ev.studentName }}` |
| Director list / grouped rows | **257, 296** | `group.student_name`, `record.student_name` |
| Export grouping | **2486–2503** | Uses `rec.student_name` or `'未命名學生'` |

```909:913:/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/LearningRecordsPage.vue
const currentStudentName = computed(() => {
  const studentId = String(form.StudentID || '');
  if (!studentId) return '未綁定堂次';
  return studentList.value.find((item) => String(item.id) === studentId)?.name || `學生 #${studentId}`;
});
```


---

## 3. Parent portal — learning records layout

**File:** `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/ParentPortal.vue`

- Card container: **198–304** (`pp-card`, `data-guide="parent-learning-card"`).
- Subject chips + grouped sections: **204–223**.
- Each record: **224–286** — `pp-report`, head (`pp-report-head`), indicators (`pp-report-indicators`), expandable body (`pp-report-body`).
- “Load more” + empty state: **290–303**.

Student name is **not** prominent in this block: the header shows **subject** and **date/time**; **teacher** appears in indicators when `record.teacher_name` is set (**256–258**).

---

## 4. Export / download / image generation (learning records)

| Piece | Path |
|-------|------|
| UI entry | `LearningRecordsPage.vue` — button **10**, modal **562+**, logic **~2408–2521** |
| Canvas PNG export | `/home/admin/frontend/src/lib/learningRecordExport.js` — `generateStudentCardPng`, `downloadBlob`, `exportStudentCards` (**264–337**) |

Flow: date range → fetch records → `exportStudentCards` → per-student **PNG** download (`評量報告_… .png`). This is **image export**, not print/`window.print` in this module.

**Other** image export in the app (not learning records): `ReceiptModal.vue`, `PaymentSlipModal.vue` use `canvas.toDataURL('image/png')` for receipts/slips.

---

## 5. “回報系統問題” modal

**File:** `/home/admin/frontend/src/components/BugReportLauncher.vue`

- Overlay + title **18–21**: `modal-overlay` with `@click.self="showForm = false"`, heading **「回報系統問題」**.
- Mounted from **`/home/admin/frontend/src/App.vue`** **151–155** (`BugReportLauncher`, only when `session && !isStandaloneParent && (isDirector || isTeacher)`).

---

## 6. Course management modal + click-outside / `@click.self`

**File:** `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/CourseManagement.vue`

- **編輯課程** overlay (**304–332**):  
  ```305:306:/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/CourseManagement.vue
    <div v-if="showEditModal" class="modal-overlay">
      <div class="modal course-modal">
  ```  
  There is **no** `@click.self` on this overlay — close via **取消** / **儲存** only.

- **Duplicate-course intercept** overlay (**341–373**): **does** use backdrop close:  
  `@click.self="showDuplicateInterceptModal = false"` at **line 342**.

Project note in **`/home/admin/docs/AI_REGRESSION_LESSONS.md`** (開課日重建 / `CourseManagement` 小節): it explicitly says **do not** add `@click.self` back on the course-management `modal-overlay` because it causes **誤觸關閉**. So the “fix” you remember is aligned with **omitting** backdrop-close on the main edit/rebuild-style overlays, not with adding it everywhere.

**LearningRecordsPage** consistently uses `@click.self` on overlays (e.g. **150, 339, 394, 563**) for the learning-record modals.

---

## File path checklist

| Topic | Path(s) |
|--------|---------|
| Learning evaluation page + modals | `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/LearningRecordsPage.vue` |
| Parent LR cards | `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/ParentPortal.vue` |
| PNG export implementation | `/home/admin/frontend/src/lib/learningRecordExport.js` |
| Bug report UI | `/home/admin/frontend/src/components/BugReportLauncher.vue` |
| Bug launcher wiring | `/home/admin/frontend/src/App.vue` |
| Course modals / duplicate intercept | `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/CourseManagement.vue` |
| Page guide copy mentioning bug report | `/home/admin/frontend/src/lib/pageGuideConfig.js` (~387) |

---

**Summary:** Treat **「學習日誌」** in product language as **學習評量** in code (`LearningRecordsPage.vue`). Student fallbacks use both `` `學生 #id` `` and `` `學生#id` `` in different places. Learning-record **export** is **PNG download** via canvas in `learningRecordExport.js`. **回報系統問題** is **`BugReportLauncher.vue`**. Course **edit** modal intentionally has **no** backdrop `@click.self`; only the **duplicate intercept** modal uses `@click.self` on the overlay in current `CourseManagement.vue`.
